_comment: Per-file byte ceilings for lifecycle SKILL.md bodies. Enforced by scripts/lint-skill-body-budget.py against the MERGE BASE, not the working tree: a working-tree read would let one diff raise both a file and its own ceiling and satisfy itself, which is how SKILL_DESCRIPTION_WORD_BUDGET reached 2442 after 14 bumps. Ceilings ratchet DOWN only -- lowering one never fails, raising one is a separate reviewed PR. Seeded at +10% headroom over the size at introduction, deliberately: a zero-headroom seed guarantees the first bump PR within a week, which reproduces the ritual this replaces. The node set comes from .claude/workflow-transitions.json, so a skill added to the lifecycle cannot silently escape. See ADR-225 and #8302.
